data.one_liner: A lightweight dependency injection library for Flutter with code generation and scopes.
data.what_it_does: Generates dependency injection registrations from annotations like @RootScoped, @Scoped, and @Factory. It offers constructor injection, interface bindings, and scope-aware lifecycles for Flutter apps.
use_when: You want annotation-based dependency injection with code generation.
Your app requires root and feature-scoped lifecycles with automatic disposal.
You prefer constructor injection for required positional and named parameters.
avoid_when: You require asynchronous factories or asynchronous dependency resolution.
You need to inject optional constructor parameters automatically.
strengths: No runtime reflection due to build_runner code generation.
Scope-aware lifecycles integrated with Flutter widgets via KoinScopeHost.
weaknesses: Generated factories and dependency resolution are strictly synchronous.
Does not support generic classes or constructors with optional parameters for injection.
Root-scoped dependencies cannot depend on feature-scoped dependencies.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_koin and build_runner as a dev dependency, then run the build_runner command to generate part files.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a service locator without code generation or part files.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more feature-complete annotation-based DI framework built on top of get_it.
